title: Building for android without 3d gives error
body:
### Tested versions

Reproductible in 4.4 stable for Linux


### System information

Linux Mint 20.2 Cinnamon

### Issue description

So I wanted to build for Android so that I can disable parts of Godot so that when I export my game.apk it has a reduced size. Since my game is 2D I wanted to disable the 3D. I ran the command and got a error about disabling 3d. 


**The command I ran:**
```
scons platform=android target=template_release debug_symbols=no lto=full optimize=size module_text_server_adv_enabled=no module_text_server_fb_enabled=yes tools=no disable_3d=yes verbose=yes
```

**The errors I got:**
```
platform/android/java_godot_lib_jni.cpp:478:28: error: use of undeclared identifier 'RenderingServer'; did you mean 'RenderingDevice'?
        String rendering_driver = RenderingServer::get_singleton()->get_current_rendering_driver_name();
                                  ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
                                  RenderingDevice
platform/android/display_server_android.h:38:7: note: 'RenderingDevice' declared here
class RenderingDevice;
      ^
platform/android/java_godot_lib_jni.cpp:478:28: error: incomplete type 'RenderingDevice' named in nested name specifier
        String rendering_driver = RenderingServer::get_singleton()->get_current_rendering_driver_name();
                                  ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
platform/android/display_server_android.h:38:7: note: forward declaration of 'RenderingDevice'
class RenderingDevice;
      ^
platform/android/java_godot_lib_jni.cpp:479:28: error: use of undeclared identifier 'RenderingServer'; did you mean 'RenderingDevice'?
        String rendering_method = RenderingServer::get_singleton()->get_current_rendering_method();
                                  ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
                                  RenderingDevice
platform/android/display_server_android.h:38:7: note: 'RenderingDevice' declared here
class RenderingDevice;
      ^
platform/android/java_godot_lib_jni.cpp:479:28: error: incomplete type 'RenderingDevice' named in nested name specifier
        String rendering_method = RenderingServer::get_singleton()->get_current_rendering_method();
                                  ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
platform/android/display_server_android.h:38:7: note: forward declaration of 'RenderingDevice'
class RenderingDevice;
      ^
4 errors generated.
```

**How I fixed it:**
I replaced 2 lines at /platform/android/java_godot_lib_jni.cpp:478 like below:
```
   #ifndef _3D_DISABLED
        String rendering_driver = RenderingServer::get_singleton()->get_current_rendering_driver_name();
        String rendering_method = RenderingServer::get_singleton()->get_current_rendering_method();
    #else
        String rendering_driver = "None";
        String rendering_method = "None";
    #endif
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Download 4.4-stable for linux : https://godotengine.org/download/linux/
2. run the command: scons platform=android target=template_release debug_symbols=no lto=full optimize=size module_text_server_adv_enabled=no module_text_server_fb_enabled=yes tools=no disable_3d=yes verbose=yes

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

This is about building Godot for Android without 3D using Linux, I got the error before any project was needed.
